question.knowledge_point: Inverting Affine Transformations Given in Matrix Form
question.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation $T$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ -4 & 7\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5\end{aligned}].
$$

Find $a+b+c,$ given that the matrix form of the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a & -2 \\ -4 & b\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}4 \\ c\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

Reversing the action of $T,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}Au+b & =x \\ Au & =x-b \\ u & ={A}^{-1}(x-b).\end{aligned}
$$

The matrix form of $T$ gives us the following information:

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ -4 & 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}
$$

Next, we calculate the inverse of $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{7\cdot 1-(-2)\cdot (-4)}[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{-1}[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7 & -2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u} & ={{[\begin{aligned}-7 & -2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{A}^{-1}}\cdot ({{[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}-{{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}) \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7 & -2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-7 & -2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7 & -2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ -3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7 & -2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=-7+(-1)+3=-5.
$$
